rules.statement: A vendor who had become liable to warrant and defend his vendee's title, upon receiving notice from his vendees of an action against them disputing their title to the land, was duty-bound to have himself added as a party to the case or otherwise do all he could to defend his vendee's title.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a vendor of a parcel of land, who by agreement or otherwise had become liable to warrant and defend his vendee's title, received notice from his vendees of an action against them disputing their title to the land, it was his duty to have himself added as a party to the case, or otherwise to do all he could to defend his vendee's title.
